blurb: Guests board the Desert Princess for a 90-minute sightseeing cruise on Lake Mead, enjoying views of the lake and surrounding area. The boat has two enclosed temperature-controlled decks and a full-service snack bar and grill. Specialty cruises and add-ons like photo packages and romance packages are also available.
